tools.name: analyze_website_aeo
tools.description: Crawl a URL, parse its HTML and structured data, and score it for answer-engine optimization (AEO). Returns an AEO-focused summary, AI-bot access, and crawl-hint files.

tools.name: check_ai_visibility
tools.description: Query Perplexity Sonar with a prompt and inspect its citations to determine whether the given URL is cited as a source, and at what rank.

tools.name: discover_ranking_prompts
tools.description: Generate realistic user prompts a site should aim to be cited for on a topic, using Perplexity Sonar. Optionally tests a few of them for live visibility.

tools.name: get_visibility_report
tools.description: Combine an AEO audit of a URL with per-prompt AI-visibility checks into a single report with an overall citation rate.

tools.name: compare_competitor_visibility
tools.description: Run one Perplexity Sonar query and rank several competitor URLs by whether and where each is cited for the prompt.
